title: Figma announces new features to define how AI agents work on its platform, including Figma Specs, a Markdown editor that lets users define their design language (Ivan Mehta/TechCrunch)
summary: Ivan Mehta / TechCrunch: Figma announces new features to define how AI agents work on its platform, including Figma Specs, a Markdown editor that lets users define their design language — Design platform Figma announced a new Markdown-based editor to help define a company's design, bring in design and code libraries …
